t: This is St Mary Aldermary, an Anglican church on Bow Lane, where it meets Watling Street in the City of London. It was designed by Christopher Wren, who was given responsibility for rebuilding 52 City churches after the Great Fire of 1666. His masterpiece is St Paul's Cathedral, just up the hill. People buried here include Sir Thomas Lodge, who served as Lord Mayor of London, and the translator Catherine Collignon, who died in 1832.
